zh.title: 內政部清查無人機採購 初盤3機關涉及32架
zh.summary: 內政部清查所屬無人機採購，初步盤點3機關涉及32架
body: 內政部表示，已主動清查所屬機關涉及亞拓科技製造無人機的採購。初步盤點顯示，3個機關採購共32架涉及該公司製造的無人機。
內政部指出，民國114年國家公園署及中央警察大學各採購亞拓公司製造的無人機1架。今年移民署透過政府採購法公開招標，向速源科技股份有限公司採購30架無人機，金額為新臺幣275萬元，且已完成決標。
內政部表示，速源科技原預計交付亞拓科技製造的無人機，但目前尚未交貨履約。移民署將依契約要求，不得交付亞拓科技製造或其他涉及中國製產品。內政部並表示，政府無人機採購須符合非紅供應鏈規定，如有違反契約規定將依約求償。

en.title: Interior Ministry reviews drone procurement involving 32 aircraft across three agencies
en.summary: The Interior Ministry reviews drone purchases involving 32 aircraft across three agencies.
body: The Interior Ministry said it has begun reviewing agency purchases involving drones manufactured by Asia Tech. Its preliminary count found that three agencies had procured 32 drones involving the company.

The National Park Service and Central Police University each procured one Asia Tech-manufactured drone in ROC year 114, the ministry said. This year, the Immigration Agency awarded a public tender to Su Yuan Technology Co., Ltd. for 30 drones at NT$2.75 million.

Su Yuan had planned to deliver drones made by Asia Tech, but they had not yet been delivered and the contract had not been fulfilled. The Immigration Agency will enforce contract terms barring delivery of Asia Tech-made drones or other products involving China-made goods. The ministry said government drone procurement must meet non-red supply-chain requirements and that it may seek compensation for contractual violations.
